title: A Twelve-Row Seed and a One-Row Extension for Five-Column Recursive-Line Zarankiewicz Numbers
summary: We prove that the five-column recursive-line Zarankiewicz number satisfies $z_{RL}(m,5)=3m+5$ for every integer $m\ge 12$. The proof is based on an explicit $12\times5$ seed configuration combined with a recursive one-row extension scheme. The seed attains the five-column cell bound and contains no unoccupied cells. Two selected pairs in the seed are opened and replaced by parallel paths, ensuring that each inserted row increases the total number of augmented edges by three while preserving the required simple configuration.
